check_instructions.description: Which `instructions` strings are read as a path to an instructions file. A string read as a path must name a file that exists, so a mistyped path fails instead of reaching the model as an instruction. Prose has whitespace and a path doesn't, so a string with any whitespace is text, even when it names a path of its own. No case names a file that exists, so `missing_file` is the error a path gets; the wording belongs to each language.

cases.name: a file name with a known extension
a file name with any extension
a relative path without an extension
a sentence naming a directory
cases.input: In run_sas, assign it with: libname trial "/srv/trial" access=readonly;
